# Metric catalog, version 1

FR-RPT-015. Generated from `report.metric` in a live database, which is the same table `report.reading()` refuses to build a metric without. This document cannot define a metric this build does not compute, and cannot omit one it does: migration 0029 refuses to apply while `report.metric_key` has a label `report.metric` has no row for, and this generator refuses to write while the two disagree.

**18 metrics.** The version is `report.catalog_version()`. Every snapshot and every export records the version it was computed under, so a figure taken before a definition changed can be recognised as answering a different question rather than as disagreeing about the same one.

## Empty windows (FR-UX-014)

`report.reading()` refuses a value that disagrees with the *empty window* column below, in both directions. **zero** means an empty window has a defined value and that value is exactly zero — no orders in a quiet hour is a true count. **no value** means an empty window has no summary at all, and reporting one would be an invention: the median preparation time over no tickets is not zero seconds. A surface renders the second as FR-UX-014's instructive empty state.

### `bill_payments_minor`

Bill payments.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| unit | minor_currency |
| formula | sum of payments.allocation.amount_minor to bill_balance, net of reversals of those allocations |
| timezone | window boundaries are instants; the outlet timezone in org.outlet_profile renders them |
| currency | minor units of the payment currency; a window is not summed across currencies |
| inclusion | allocations made in the window; a reversal reduces the window it was made in |
| data source | `payments.allocation` |
| empty window | zero — no payment in a window is a sum over an empty set, which is exactly zero |

### `kitchen_exceptions`

Kitchen exceptions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| unit | count |
| formula | count of fulfillment.waste_event rows recorded in the window |
| timezone | window boundaries are instants; the outlet timezone in org.outlet_profile renders them |

### `kitchen_preparation_seconds_p50`

Preparation time (median).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| unit | seconds |
| formula | discrete median of ready_at minus preparation_started_at, in whole seconds |
| timezone | a duration, so the timezone does not enter it; the window that selects the rows is instants |
| currency | not a monetary metric |
| inclusion | only tickets released in the window that both started and became ready |
| data source | `fulfillment.ticket` |
| empty window | no value — the median of an empty set is undefined; zero seconds would say every dish was instant |

### `kitchen_queue_depth`

| | |
| --- | --- |
| unit | count |

| currency | not a monetary metric |
| inclusion | tickets released in the window whose state has not reached preparing |
| data source | `fulfillment.ticket` |
| empty window | zero — a window with nothing waiting had zero waiting, and that is an observation |

## Dashboards (FR-RPT-001)

Every panel of every Phase 1 role. A panel names a label of `report.metric_key` and nothing else — there is no free-text panel and no panel that names a table — so a deferred module cannot reach the reporting surface through a data row.


### `cashier` — Till

For the cashier, who is accountable for what was taken and given back.
